question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH purchase_events AS (
    SELECT se.cookie_id, se.visit_id, se.sequence_number, se.event_time
    FROM shopping_cart_events se
    WHERE se.event_type = 3
),
product_events AS (
    SELECT se.cookie_id, se.visit_id, se.page_id, se.event_type, se.sequence_number, se.event_time, sph.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events se
    LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy sph ON se.page_id = sph.page_id
    WHERE se.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
    AND sph.product_id IS NOT NULL
),
purchase_with_product AS (
    SELECT pe2.cookie_id, pe2.visit_id, pe2.product_id, pe2.event_time as product_event_time, pe2.sequence_number as product_seq
    FROM purchase_events pe
    JOIN product_events pe2 ON pe.cookie_id = pe2.cookie_id AND pe.visit_id = pe2.visit_id
    WHERE pe2.event_type IN (1, 2)
    AND pe2.event_time < pe.event_time
    AND pe2.product_id IS NOT NULL
    AND pe2.sequence_number = (
        SELECT MAX(pe3.sequence_number) 
        FROM product_events pe3 
        WHERE pe3.cookie_id = pe.cookie_id 
        AND pe3.visit_id = pe.visit_id 
        AND pe3.event_type IN (1, 2)
        AND pe3.event_time < pe.event_time
    )
),
purchase_counts AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as purchases
    FROM purchase_with_product
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT ps.product_id,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.event_type = 1 THEN 1 END) as views,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.event_type = 2 THEN 1 END) as cart_additions,
       (COUNT(CASE WHEN ps.event_type = 2 THEN 1 END) - COALESCE(pc.purchases, 0)) as left_in_cart,
       COALESCE(pc.purchases, 0) as purchases
FROM product_events ps
LEFT JOIN purchase_counts pc ON ps.product_id = pc.product_id
GROUP BY ps.product_id, pc.purchases
ORDER BY ps.product_id
